name: Motiq
summary: Free MIT animated React/shadcn components as editable source — app owns state.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~86 components / 100 registry items — not a full inventory.
Source is app-owned: Motiq installs editable presentation UI; your app supplies state/data (no Motiq backend lock-in).
Import path after CLI: `@/components/motiq/{slug}`; utils/primitives pulled as registry deps.
kinetic-emphasis has no honest EffectType enum match beyond empty [] (motion emphasis, not a locked tag).
iframe demos only; component pages at /components/{slug}.

components.name: Decrypt Text
components.summary: Copy that arrives decoded rather than typed — glyphs boil then resolve.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @motiq/decrypt-text

import { DecryptText } from "@/components/motiq/decrypt-text"

<DecryptText text="Ship interfaces that feel alive." as="h1" />

copyPrompt.text: Use Motiq free component `Decrypt Text` (slug `decrypt-text`) from https://motiq.dev/components/decrypt-text. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @motiq/decrypt-text` (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://motiq.dev/r/decrypt-text.json`). @motiq is listed in the shadcn registry directory — no components.json entry required on current CLI. Registry item: https://motiq.dev/r/decrypt-text.json. Import from `@/components/motiq/decrypt-text` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Editable source lands in your app — Motiq is presentation/UI; your application owns state/data (no backend lock-in). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind; some items also need `motion`. Free & open source MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RMahammad/motiq/main/LICENSE).
